logdir.description: Directory where the service stores its runtime logs.

datadir.description: Directory for storing temporary and staging files.

workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle incoming requests.

max_transfers.description: Maximum number of concurrent file transfers allowed.

verbose.description: Enable or disable verbose logging (more detailed than debug).

server_host.description: Network interface address the service listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '127.0.0.1').

server_port.description: TCP port the service listens on.

cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file for HTTPS. Leave empty to use HTTP only.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file. Required if cert_file is set.

storage_base_path.description: Root directory where user data is stored on disk.

max_file_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) for a single uploaded file.

max_quota_per_user.description: Maximum total storage (in bytes) allowed per user.

enforce_quota.description: If enabled, reject uploads that would exceed per-user quotas.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN where users are located in the LDAP directory.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN for service account to bind to LDAP (optional for anonymous binds).

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Required if bind_dn is set.

ldap_username_attr.description: LDAP attribute used as the username (e.g., 'uid' or 'sAMAccountName').

email_enabled.description: Enable email notifications for transfer completion (success/failure).

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (common: 587 for TLS, 465 for implicit TLS).

smtp_tls.description: Enable TLS for SMTP connection (STARTTLS on port 587 or implicit TLS on 465).

from_address.description: From email address used in notifications.

cleanup_workers.description: Number of background threads for cleaning up expired/stale files.

quota_workers.description: Number of background threads for enforcing per-user quotas.

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed client IP ranges (CIDR notation) to whitelist.

blocked_ips.description: List of blocked client IP ranges (CIDR notation) to deny.
